about:
Keystone Solutions Group operates from Kalamazoo, Michigan, where it has provided medical device contract manufacturing services for more than 25 years. The company is led by President Jim Medsker and a leadership team that includes VP of Sales and Business Development Jason Barr, VP of Engineering Vaughn Gerber, and Director of Quality & Regulatory William Reinholt.

The company specializes in assembly, kitting, packaging, converting, and sterilization management, supporting programs from prototype and pilot builds through full-scale production. Its facility includes multiple clean room environments, and it extends beyond core manufacturing to offer supply chain sourcing, warehousing, and distribution services. A dedicated Customer Product Transfer Process manages product transfers from project planning to commercial release.

Keystone serves the medical device industry worldwide, producing single-use disposable and reusable medical products. Its customers range from start-ups to established OEMs seeking end-to-end manufacturing, packaging, and sterilization solutions.

The company emphasizes a collaborative approach that addresses regulatory, intellectual property, and commercial challenges, aiming to break the mold of typical OEM/contract manufacturer relationships. Its stated values focus on complete end-to-end solutions from concept through approval and production.
